title: Customers tab shows 50 a page and keeps search, filter and page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data' and 'Customers — View'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have at least 51 customers on tier A for work orders (put customers made for this test on it if needed).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Go to the second page.
  5. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  6. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  7. Click the Customers tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The first page lists 50 customers.

Step 4:

  • The second page lists the rest (51 − 50 = 1 or more).

Step 5:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 6:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 7:

  • The Customers tab opens on the second page again.
  • The same customers as before are listed.
